idea: Taskmaster: Build a complete workflow, not just a chatbot. Don't just make an agent that writes text. Make one that takes action. Find a messy, multi-step chore in your job, classes, or personal life. Build an agent that handles the details, sends the right info to the right places, and proves it can do the heavy lifting for you.

brand.name: Gantry
brand.audience: Operations leads drowning in multi-app manual workarounds
brand.visualConcept: A high-contrast blueprint and terminal aesthetic featuring heavy grid lines, mechanical workflow schematics, and physical status indicators instead of soft SaaS illustrations.
brand.layout: A single-column pipeline layout that visually funnels the user from a live, interactive workflow simulator in the hero down through a series of connected, step-by-step integration cards.
creativeNotes: Use a monospace font family like JetBrains Mono for all UI elements and workflow steps to emphasize the programmatic, reliable nature of the agent.
Replace generic SaaS icons with custom SVG schematics showing input nodes, processing states, and output destinations connected by animated, pulsing pipeline lines.
Build an interactive 'dry-run' simulator in the hero section where investors can trigger a 3-step workflow and watch the agent update real-time execution logs.

mvp.name: Gantry

experience.motif: High-contrast blueprint grid lines with physical status indicators [ OK ] and pulsing pipeline nodes acting as sidebar navigation

mvp.headline: Stop prompting. Start executing.
mvp.subheadline: A deterministic execution engine designed to replace brittle multi-app manual workarounds with resilient, self-healing agent pipelines.

googleCapabilities.label: Gantry Schema Compiler
googleCapabilities.rationale: Translates unstructured, messy manual operations descriptions into strict, deterministic state-machine execution schemas with automated error-recovery nodes.

config.assistantRole: You are the Gantry Compiler, a precise, deterministic system architect. You convert natural language descriptions of manual operations workflows into strict, JSON-based state machine schemas with error-recovery nodes. Do not output conversational filler. Output raw, structured execution steps with input/output validation rules.
config.speechPrompt: Compile the manual workflow into a deterministic state machine schema.

screens.label: COMPILER
screens.title: Deterministic Schema Compiler
screens.description: Describe a messy, multi-step manual chore. The Gantry compiler will generate a strict, self-healing state machine schema.

items.title: Example: Customer Refund Verification
